title: OP script
features:
OP unlock helicopter
tp to finish
auto farm
script:
if game.PlaceId == 87583185172012 then
    local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
    local Window = Library.CreateLib("Like Pls", "DarkTheme")
    
    local MainTab = Window:NewTab("Main Stuff")
    local MainSection = MainTab:NewSection("Free")
    
    MainSection:NewButton("Free Helicopter", "like pls", function()
        game.workspace.Lobby.HeliArea:Destroy()
    end)
    
    MainSection:NewButton("TP to finish", "like pls", function()
        local rootPart = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        rootPart.CFrame = workspace.Finish.Chest.CFrame
    end)
    
    MainSection:NewToggle("Auto Farm", "like pls", function(state)
        if state then
            _G.loop = true
            while _G.loop == true do wait(0.5)
                print("Toggle on")
    
                local rootPart = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                rootPart.CFrame = workspace.Finish.Chest.CFrame wait(2)
            end
        else
            _G.loop = false
            while _G.loop do wait()
                print("Toggle off")
    
                local rootPart = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                rootPart.CFrame = workspace.Finish.Chest.CFrame wait(2)
            end
        end
    end)
    
    end
